name: bounded-zero-learning-rate-pause
mutation: Set every current optimizer parameter-group learning rate to zero for exactly 800 optimizer calls, then restore the prefix-native group learning rates.

predicted_mechanism_state_change.rule_margin: held near its intervention-start value during the pause
predicted_mechanism_state_change.stress_phase: rephased because Adam moments continue to evolve

mechanism_state_change: Suppress 800 parameter/decay-progress steps while advancing Adam moment age by 800 steps; hold rule margin near its cut value and rephase optimizer stress.
stability_effect_rationale: The pause shifts decay exposure and rule-margin formation while allowing Adam first/second moments and step counters to evolve. It therefore rephases individual stress pulses, but it neither removes the moment/gradient feedback nor changes the long-run learning rate, clipping threshold, or parameter groups, so the predicted stability class remains transient degradation with recovery.
